title: What Cottrell taught: snare roll, pad and counting time
summary: Cottrell stressed snare drum and a good roll, practice on a pad, and beating time with the foot while counting.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear

blocks.x: What did he emphasize in teaching you? Did he emphasize the snare drum, the bass drum, or any particular...
No, I was the snare drum.
He tried to teach you that, huh?
Snare drum, yeah. Good roll, you know. Did you use a drum pad at first? Well, I used a drum pad.
Before you went to the actual drum pad.
Yeah, actual drums, yeah, drum pad.
Did you teach anything about patting your foot?
Well, yeah, you know how to beat time, you know.
How would he show you? What would he tell you?
Well, just hold my feet. And count? Yeah, I'd count a whole lot, yeah.
Would you count for every time you beat your foot down?
My foot down, yeah. I'm a tempo and everything.
